name: Self-Assessment of Mental States (Eysenck)
description: This self-assessment of mental states is one of the personality questionnaires developed by H. Eysenck (1960s–1980s). Eysenck's questionnaires grew out of his new typological approach to personality, drawing on the theories of C. Jung, R. Woodworth, I. P. Pavlov, E. Kretschmer and other psychologists, psychiatrists and physiologists, as well as his own extensive experimental research. They have fairly high validity and reliability and are widely used in practical assessment.
instruction: Read each statement carefully and choose one of three answers: "Fits me", "Fits me, but not much" or "Doesn't fit me".

1.text: I don't feel confident in myself

5.text: I worry about troubles that are still only imagined

7.text: I like dwelling on my shortcomings

10.text: I find waiting hard to bear

11.text: Situations that do have a way out often seem hopeless to me

12.text: Troubles upset me a lot and I lose heart

13.text: When things go badly wrong, I tend to blame myself without good reason

14.text: Misfortunes and failures teach me nothing

15.text: I often give up the fight, thinking it pointless

18.text: I feel at a loss when faced with difficulties

19.text: In hard times I sometimes act like a child and want to be pitied

20.text: I think the flaws in my character can't be fixed.

21.text: I like to have the last word

22.text: I often interrupt people when talking

25.text: I want to be respected as an authority by the people around me

26.text: I'm not satisfied with little; I want the most

27.text: When I'm angry, I find it hard to control myself

28.text: I would rather lead than follow

29.text: My gestures are sharp and rather rough

31.text: I find it hard to change my habits

33.text: I'm very cautious about anything new

34.text: It's hard to change my mind

35.text: Thoughts I should let go of often stay stuck in my head

36.text: I don't get close to people easily

37.text: Even small changes to a plan upset me

40.text: I react strongly to any change in the daily routine I've set

summaries.Не имеет высокой самооценки, устойчив к: Self-esteem is not low; resilient to failure and not afraid of difficulties
summaries.Низкая самооценка, избегает трудностей,: Low self-esteem, avoids difficulties, afraid of failure. High frustration
summaries.Агрессивен, не выдержан, есть трудности: Aggressive and lacking self-control; has difficulties communicating and working with people.
summaries.Сильно выраженная ригидность, неизменнос: Marked rigidity: behaviour, beliefs and views stay fixed
